description: Check before connecting (TAS Check): give a name, link, Telegram or X @handle, GitHub repo or app-store link of a Telegram trading bot, web trading terminal, exchange, swap service or wallet (incl. Zcash/Monero wallets). Returns whether the link is on that service's official list (confirmed from two independent places), a known fake, or a lookalike that uses its name, plus the worst case for your money, who holds the keys, freeze/hold policy, what a leaked API key can do, Monero/Zcash support, what the service collects about you and any data breaches, incidents, deadlines and a 3-step safe setup, each with sources. For a hardware wallet (by name, maker or website: Ledger, Trezor, Coldcard, OneKey, BitBox, Tangem, Keystone, Jade, Passport, CoolWallet) it also returns the custody score from tradingagentstack.com/custody/. For a shop, it says which maker names it on its own authorized-reseller list (Ledger, Trezor, BitBox, CoolWallet), flags marketplaces, and flags shops whose reseller authorization was revoked. Unknown links are reported as unknown, never as safe.
name: check
